reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one that names the lab and puts the batch report behind a QR code, which is what I check before buying. Bisglycinate at 200 mg with no oxide and a money-back guarantee makes one box at the launch price an easy trial.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month feels like a lot of packaging waste, and I would want to open the lab report and confirm the lab and batch number are real before I trust it. Made in China also makes me want to see that report first.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not match the batch number or the lab could not be verified, I would not buy.
